out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Parasite Destruction
violations.observation: The following fish offered for service or sale in the ready-to-eat form was not frozen to ensure parasite destruction: SALMON
violations.corrective_action: Before service or sale in ready-to-eat form, raw or partially cooked fish shall be: 1) frozen and stored at a temperature of -4F or below for a minimum of 7 days in a freezer, or 2) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -31F or below for a minimum of 15 hours, or 3) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -4F or below for a minimum of 24 hours.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw shell eggs on top of marinara sauce and vegetables in unit # 3, raw chicken on top of cooked chicken in unit # 2 and raw fish on top of avocados in unit # 8 and 7
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM relocated raw shell eggs, raw fish, raw chicken to the bottom shelves.

violations.title: (2017) RTE TCS Food, Date Marking Based on Ingredients
violations.observation: The following ready-to-eat food that is made using a combination of ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety ingredients is not properly dated for discard using the date of the first-prepared ingredient: Observed curry in unit # 3, cooked sliced pork in unit # 4 without preparation date.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that combined with additional ingredients, or portions of the same food, must retain the date marking of the earliest or first prepared ingredient. CFM date marked curry and cooked sliced pork JAPOMEN ALEXANDRIA (Inspection Date: 07/01/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): SUSHI RICE
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EHS and CFM completed and sign the form.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Observed multiples squeeze bottles without name label.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM labeled all squeeze bottles.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor behind fryers and storage units and coolers doors in the kitchen are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CFM will deep cleaning floor and clean and sanitize coolers doors.

violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. Items removed and sink now accessible.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed unlabeled spray bottle of cleaner.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. Bottle was labeled. JAPOMEN ALEXANDRIA (Inspection Date: 12/19/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: pork thawing at room temperature on counter.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. Education on proper thawing provided.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: rice scoops stored in ambient water and knives stored between counter tops.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Education provided on proper utensils storage.
